✦ Meet your future product companion

Ask Little Joys

A proposed AI assistant that answers product questions using verified product information.

CONCEPTUAL BLUEPRINT · NOT LIVE AI

How the assistant is planned to work

1

Understand the question
Customer asks about an ingredient, serving size, claim or precaution.

2

Retrieve verified information
RAG finds relevant information from an approved Little Joys product knowledge base.

3

Explain clearly
Gemini generates a plain-language answer grounded in the retrieved product facts.

4

Know when to hand off
Personal medical questions are directed to a qualified healthcare professional.

Does jaggery mean this spread is sugar-free?
Not necessarily! Jaggery is still a source of sugar. To understand the product's sugar content, check the total and added sugars on its nutrition panel.
Can you tell me if it is suitable for my child?
I can help you find the age guidance and allergen information printed on the pack. For your child's individual needs, please check with their healthcare professional.

Illustrative conversation only. These are example responses, not generated by a connected chatbot.

✦ BUILT FROM CUSTOMER DISCOVERY

Every customer concern has a next step.

Based on five customer conversations across three Little Joys products. This section connects each concern to what the prototype addresses now and what is planned for verification or future development. Customer names are not displayed.

✓ Implemented in prototype◷ Planned / needs verification
MOM MULTIVITAMIN GUMMIESCustomer 1

Benefit expectations

Concern: How long might it take to notice changes in energy, hair or skin?

✓ Implemented

Explains that results vary and no universal benefit timeline is established. Avoids promising results within a fixed number of days.

◷ Planned

Request brand-supported evidence and approved wording before publishing a specific benefit timeframe.

MOM MULTIVITAMIN GUMMIESCustomer 2

Inulin, nutrients, precautions & price

Concern: Possible digestive discomfort, unclear nutrient quantities, pregnancy/breastfeeding guidance and affordability.

✓ Implemented

Explains inulin and possible gas/bloating; displays published nutrient information where available; includes a clinician-consultation caution; shows pack price and per-gummy cost.

◷ Planned

Confirm exact inulin quantity, full nutrient amounts and serving basis from the current pack. Obtain brand-confirmed pregnancy guidance and verify subscription, multipack or loyalty offers.

NUTRIMIX NUTRITION POWDERCustomer 3

Sugar, protein, vitamin forms & value

Concern: Sugar positioning, protein quantity, vitamin/mineral forms and value for money. Customer discontinued after a short trial.

✓ Implemented

Explains jaggery and dates; distinguishes “no refined sugar” from sugar-free; shows price per serving; presents the website's 5 g protein claim alongside the customer's approximately 6 g report as an unresolved discrepancy.

◷ Planned

Verify protein and total/added sugar against the exact pack. Add a complete label-based nutrient table and balanced value comparison including protein, sugar, calories and fibre.

NUTRIMIX NUTRITION POWDERCustomer 4

Child-specific nutrient suitability

Concern: Whether nutrient types and quantities are appropriate for the child's needs; parent sought medical reassurance.

✓ Implemented

Shows product age guidance and ingredient explanations, flags variant differences and advises professional consultation for individual needs and supplement overlap.

◷ Planned

Build a label-based nutrient breakdown with exact amounts per serving and sourced age-reference context, reviewed by a qualified health professional. Keep it educational, not diagnostic.

CHOCOLATE HAZELNUT SPREADCustomer 5

Sugar clarity, price & pack size

Concern: Jaggery/sugar positioning, total sugar clarity, price and pack affordability.

✓ Implemented

Explains that jaggery is still a sugar source; shows current listed pack price and price per 100 g; displays the published ingredient list.

◷ Planned

Verify total and added sugar per 100 g and per serving from the current jar. Confirm smaller packs or other pack sizes before listing them.

How to read this tracker: “Implemented” means the prototype currently explains or displays the concern. “Planned” means additional pack evidence, brand confirmation, expert review or future development is still required. The app cannot itself change product formulation, price or availability.
